name: Onyxia
source: [logs: Season of Discovery] Melee 3,029 to 4,428 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 2.22 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 20 kills on Season of Discovery (Normal, 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-01): the median of 121 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (3,678), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (120 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 2,468 weapon damage, spread 0.567, a 1.85 s swing. Length: the main tank's time on him a kill, median 124 s (10th to 90th percentile 48 to 184). Weapon damage abilities: Cleave 19983 3,061 to 4,679 from 41 hits; Knock Away 19633 2,677 to 4,697 from 21 hits. Abilities: Flame Breath 18435 3,063 to 3,937 Fire every 10 to 20 s, frontal on the tank. Cleave 19983 weapon damage + 50 every 2 to 5 s. Knock Away 19633 weapon damage + 30 every 15 to 30 s. Wing Buffet 18500 563 to 937 every 15 to 30 s. Values from the Classic Era client's spell data, timers from the vmangos script.

notes: Phase 1 and 3 on the ground only (the air phase at 65% to 40% is left out). Knock Away's 25% threat cut and Bellowing Roar's fear aren't modelled.

healing.notes: From Season of Discovery's logs (20 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 3 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 920 a second with overheal and absorbs (42% of the heals effective), 1.29 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 461 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (8% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 6, Shaman 5, Paladin 3, Warlock 3, Druid 2, Rogue 1.
